El comediante fracasado Arthur Fleck tropieza con el amor verdadero mientras está encarcelado en Arkham. A la espera del juicio por el asesinato de cinco personas, Fleck descubre la música que siempre ha estado dentro de él.

Después de que su compromiso de casamiento sorpresivamente terminara, Joshy y sus amigos deciden hacer igualmente la despedida de soltero para levantarle el ánimo. Esta se convertirá en un fin de semana lleno de alcohol, drogas y chicas desconocidas.

Simón se asocia con unos criminales para robar un cuadro. Después de recibir un golpe en la cabeza durante el robo, contrata a una hipnoterapeuta para hurgar en su mente y descubrir el lugar en el que está escondida la valiosa obra de arte.
Lucien Greaves cofunda el Templo Satánico, un movimiento religioso que promueve la separación de iglesia y estado.

Marianne es una pintora que recibe un encargo muy especial: retratar a Héloïse, quien acaba de salir del convento y va a casarse. Este retrato de bodas tiene que realizarse sin que ella lo sepa, por lo que Marianne la investigará a diario.

Sara acaba de llegar a Los Ángeles y, aunque al principio se siente aislada entre sus nuevos compañeros de la escuela secundaria, pronto entabla amistad con tres chicas con las que comparte su pasión por las ciencias ocultas y los poderes especiales.
Tres estudiantes de cine se pierden en un bosque habitado por una bruja, durante su investigación de la leyenda.

Un empresario organiza un recorrido nocturno por el lugar donde ocurrió el tristemente célebre proyecto de "La bruja de Blair". Varios estudiantes universitarios participan, sin saber que se cierne sobre ellos la noche más larga de sus vidas.

Unos jóvenes investigan la desaparición de la hermana de uno de ellos, de quien se perdió el rastro en 1994 en un bosque vinculado a la leyenda de la bruja de Blair. Al llegar al lugar, conocen a un grupo de personas que se ofrecen a guiarlos.

Un asesino enmascarado mata a Tree Gelbman, una estudiante universitaria. A partir de entonces, ella revive el mismo día desde primera hora de la mañana, una y otra vez, sin lograr averiguar quién la asesina todos los días.
La premonición de un hombre salva a varias personas del fatal colapso de un puente y varias almas desafortunadas descubren que la muerte no puede ser engañada.
Una pareja adicta al trabajo decide tomarse unas vacaciones buceando en las Bahamas. Sin embargo, la lancha que los lleva al medio de la mar los abandona en unas aguas infestadas de tiburones.
Una discusión con su esposa provoca que un médico (Tom Cruise) inicie una odisea sexual en Nueva York.
Un infante de marina y sus compañeros se enfrentan al entrenamiento básico bajo la guía de un sargento sádico y pelean en la ofensiva Tet de 1968.
Un criminal en la Inglaterra del futuro pasa una serie de procesos experimentales para corregir sus impulsos violentos.

p.t: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
p.d: Whitmer chronicles his chaotic adolescence, from skateboarding tales to ruining a Benihana birthday party.

p.t: Lil Rel Howery: I Said It. Y'all Thinking It.
p.d: Lil Rel Howery, actor and comedian, brings his signature storytelling style and spot-on impressions to the Chicago Theater, speaking about fame, fatherhood, and therapy in a satirical way.

p.t: Chris Fleming: Live at the Palace
p.d: Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality; Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines and more.
Martin Lawrence performs his stand-up comedy routine in a concert recorded at Brooklyn's Majestic Theatre.

Eric Noone begins a forbidden romance with Rose Davenport, the lady of the house at a posh English manor. When an unexpected murder occurs, Eric gets framed, leaving Rose and her family's future uncertain.

A weekend retreat has deadly consequences when a father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route to find his billionaire boss, who seeks to exploit the creature's miraculous curative properties.
Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance.

Post-apocalyptic warriors Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock must rely on their wits and weapons more than ever as they find themselves in a relentless battle against smarter, faster and seemingly indestructible zombies.

Dumped by her husband, longtime housewife Deanna turns regret into reset by going back to college. Winding up at the same school as her daughter, Deanna plunges headlong into the campus experience -- embracing the fun, the freedom and the frat boys.
As two clans descend on the scene of young twins' birthday, Greg Focker's moonlighting at a pharmaceutical company threatens to derail his position of trust with Jack, his uptight father-in-law.

Hoping for one last hurrah, Mike Lane heads to London with a wealthy socialite who lures him with an offer he can't refuse. With everything on the line, he soon finds himself trying to whip a hot new roster of talented dancers into shape.

Jaime Reyes finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology called the Scarab. When the Scarab chooses Jaime to be its symbiotic host, he's bestowed with a suit of armor that's capable of extraordinary and unpredictable powers.
A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.
A self-styled Lothario (Ryan Gosling) teaches a suddenly single 40-something (Steve Carell) how to be a hit with the ladies.

Documentarian Marty DiBergi follows Spinal Tap as they prepare for a reunion concert. Joined by Paul McCartney and Elton John, they wrestle with their checkered past to put on a show that they hope will solidify their place in rock 'n' roll history.

p.d: After 22 years in the Marines, a couple sells their home and live in an RV to save up for their dream home in South Carolina; she wants a place that's big and luxurious, but he thinks they can still live somewhat modestly in something smaller.

After years of living all over the U.S., including in their van, a couple's ready to settle down in Austin, Texas; they're looking for something with room for future kids, and she wants to go big, but he's sweating the money.

After 25 years of marriage, journalism professors look for their first home in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. They need a place that fit all the family treasures she's accumulated, and she doesn't mind spending more to get it, but he's unwilling to budge.

For their next home in Philadelphia, a married couple looks for a place big enough to start a family; he aspires to be a stay-at-home dad and wants space in the suburbs, but she prefers to find a townhouse in the city.

A couple with busy lives and careers get an opportunity to make a big change with a new job in hot Barbados. They're looking for a place with outdoor space for their dogs, but she doesn't mind stretching their budget to get what she wants.

After a rough breakup and some soul-searching, a woman is ready to leave St. Louis for Tulum, Mexico; she's hoping her newfound confidence will help her buy a smart investment property, but her budget may not stretch to both the beach and the city.

Una foto autografiada de Babe Ruth provoca una intensa pelea, es rara y un excelente recuerdo del béisbol. Un vistazo a una colección de 400 globos oculares de vidrio protésicos antiguos.
La chaqueta de "Pulp Fiction"; guantes de ópera firmados por Clark Gable; colección de Lonnie Hammargren.
Mike Wolfe y Frank Fritz, coleccionistas de antigüedades y amigos de la infancia, recorren los Estados Unidos en busca de artefactos raros y tesoros nacionales.

Mike y Frank son regañados cuando llegan tarde a una cita con el Dr. Fred; una vez que pasan al asistente gruñón, se encuentran en un mundo extraño lleno de todo tipo de cosas extrañas y maravillosas.
El coche Hot Wheels más raro del mundo, el Beach Boom 1, entra en la tienda; Rick se pone creativo al momento de revisar un aguafuerte de Rembrandt; Chum decide escribir sus memorias.

Una medalla de servicio del Canal de Panamá de 1965 es presentada en la tienda; Corey pone su mira en una ballesta de la época del Renacimiento; Chumlee se encuentra en problemas cuando él no puede llamar a un experto.
Una pistola Colt Paterson de 1838 propiedad de un coronel de la Guerra Civil estadounidense; una carta escrita por el Presidente Franklin Roosevelt; Rick pierde su almuerzo.
Un hombre lleva un rifle Smith de la Guerra Civil Estadounidense; un cartel de la campaña presidencial de John F. Kennedey en 1960; los hombres obligan a Corey a ver "Star Wars".

Aparece el archivo del secuestro del bebé Lindbergh, uno de los casos más sonados de la historia criminal. Para los amantes de los autos deportivos, un Lotus Europa de 1974, irresistible. Además, un mosquetón del siglo 17.

Los chicos le organizan una despedida de soltero a Rick; una extraña copia de un vendedor de "Las Aventuras de Tom Sawyer"; el Viejo le enseña a Lili sobre la historia de Las Vegas cuando llegan unas monedas antiguas de un casino.

After his daughter kills his wife, a California con man weds his wife's sister.

Outside of Orlando, life is no longer a fairytale for childhood sweethearts Mike and Laurie Shaver; fighting and infidelities lead to shattered vases and broken dreams; when police search their backyard in 2018, what they find scars the family.

Las Seychelles son famosas por ofrecer una escapada idílica para las parejas de luna de miel gracias a sus aguas cristalinas y arenas blancas. Sin embargo, en 2011, el archipiélago fue sacudido por dos ataques de tiburones.
Un paraíso tropical se convierte en una de las islas más mortales del mundo debido a ataques de tiburones.

En la costa de Nueva Jersey, el verano de 1916 marcó el nacimiento del miedo a los tiburones en los EE. UU. Los investigadores creen que deben resolver el mayor misterio relacionado con el ataque de tiburones antes de que la historia se repita.
San Diego es uno de los destinos costeros más visitados de Estados Unidos. Pero en 2009, esta comunidad se vio sacudida por una serie de ataques de tiburones.
La costa de Recife es uno de los lugares más peligrosos debido a los ataques de tiburones.

Es sabido que el gran tiburón blanco merodea la costa oeste de Australia. Sin embargo, tras siglos de armoniosa convivencia, en el año 2010 algo alteró el equilibrio y el número de ataques se disparó.

A pawsome season of short films featuring man's best friend. Includes 'The Scenario' where a man faces a heartbreaking moment with his dog; a man recruited by a modern slavery ring finds a friend in 'Dog Run'; and animation 'The Soloists'.

When a couple argue about a party and neither will back down, they decide to re-create the evening to determine who is right.

Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle.
When Cheech and Chong wind up in Amsterdam, they decide to organize a show in order to help out a flailing film festival.
An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet, thought to be the key to saving the world, is accompanied by a fellowship of strangers embarking on a quest to vanquish a tyrant bent on a terrible deed.
Friends and lovers try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships, sometimes misconstruing the true intentions of the opposite sex.

Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival.
Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies.
Ensconced in her sprawling San Jose, California mansion, eccentric firearm heiress Sarah Winchester believes she is haunted by the souls of people killed by the Winchester repeating rifle.
With their futures threatened by false accusations of cheating, three teenagers take matters into their own hands.

Two cops must confront their teenage angst all over again when they go undercover as high-school students.

p.t: The Battle of Normandy: 85 Days in Hell
p.d: On D-Day, Allied forces land in Normandy, France, to beat back the German troops and liberate France; previously unseen archival footage captures the 85-day struggle to liberate Europe and includes rare images of the battle itself.

Newly restored film footage uncovers the story of the iconic B-17 and its contribution to the victory during World War II, including first-hand tales from veterans and the restoration of the plane for the National Museum of the U.S. Air Force.
Personal accounts of the atomic attack on Hiroshima in 1945; the comprehensive story of the bombing of Hiroshima, from those who built it, dropped it, and survived it.
Footage of the Pacific campaign during World War II and Japan's downfall.
The only cruise ship designed specifically to navigate the treasures and dangers at the southern tip of South America.
Follow mega cruiser Regal Princess as she whisks guests to Germany, Russia, and Scandinavia in style.
We follow passengers and crew aboard Viking Star during its two-week tour from Barcelona to its home port in Bergen, Norway.
The world's latest, most-advanced expedition cruise ship Roald Amundsen whisks passengers on an adventurous voyage to Antarctica.
The Sky Princess carries passengers from Fort Lauderdale, Florida, to three Central American stops.
The new Viking Sea cruise ship whisks guests away on a journey across the Arctic Circle and into the heart of Norway.
The Carnival Vista is the new flagship for one of the world's largest cruise lines, carrying more than 4,600 passengers and boasting 10 restaurants, nearly 2,000 staterooms and a crew of 1,400.
Royal Clipper is the largest sailing cruise ship in the world, celebrating tall ships of the 19th century while offering modern-day service for its guests.
Passengers on Ecuador's Tren Crucero experience a dangerous rail journey, which includes tropical jungles, volcanoes and the Devil's Nose.
Switzerland's Bernina Express is one of three railway lines on the UNESCO World Heritage list; it navigates 55 tunnels and nearly 200 viaducts and bridges.
The Ghan takes passengers on a three-day, two-night journey through Australia; the Pichi Pichi Railway offers passengers a trip on an original steam locomotive train.

Luan is locked in a cell in the basement; Mom goes undercover as a student at the high school and becomes best friends with Leni, Luna and Luan.

When Stella's music box disappears at school, the gang immediately suspects a student urban legend known as the Rat Beast; after a night of zombie movies, Clyde and Lincoln find an empty Loud house and assume it's a zombie apocalypse.
Lisa gets invited to work at an institute and get away from her crazy family; Lori and Bobby worry that long-distance dating is causing them to lose their connection.

After Walt's failed attempt at romance, Charles, Cliff and Geo try to find their pal a love connection; Lincoln and Clyde beg their parents to let them go to space cadets camp, but it's not as fun as they expected.

When Luna discovers that the high school music club will be axed due to budget cuts, she leads a protest; desperate to play Lincoln's trash-themed video game, Lana conspires to distract her brother away from the console.
Clyde, worried that Lincoln is hung up on Ronnie Anne, tries to cure his post-breakup blues; tired of her siblings walking all over her, Lucy turns to a spell book to teach her siblings a lesson.

Dad and Lincoln get on "Legends of the Hidden Temple" and cannot wait to for a whole day of father-and-son bonding; Lincoln wants to go to the mall but has to watch his younger sisters, so he decides to take them to the mall.

Finally tired of doing favors for Lori to get rides, Lincoln decides to help Leni pass her driver's test; Lincoln and nine of his sisters work as a team to thwart the tyranny they face with Lori as their babysitter.

All ten of Lincoln's sisters want to use the new kiddie pool he has purchased, but it is not large enough for all of them; after noticing that none of his sisters share his interests, Lincoln tries to mold Lily into his mini-me.

A vulnerable young woman falls in love and builds a life with a much older man, until their marriage takes a toxic turn; as pressure builds within their relationship, she must make a life-changing decision: escape or join his misguided revenge plot.
Known as the "James Brown of Rap," Mystikal helped put New Orleans rap on the map.

Jack keeps getting himself into trouble, so Dre chaperones the twins' school dance to keep an eye on him; Junior fights with his girlfriend after she thinks he spends too much time taking care of Devante.

Dre's sister Rhonda takes Jack and Diane to her part of town in a black neighborhood and claims the twins are scared of their own community; Bow becomes the "office mom" at work, and Junior tries to help her break the label.
Junior gets an offer for his dream job working with Migos, but Dre and Bow are determined to convince him to return to college and get his degree.
Dre is excited when Jack makes the football team, but Bow is against the idea; Diane wants Junior to drive her to her first real date with Jalen, but Junior overstays.
Denise has to live with the repercussions of breaking one of the monitor's new rules; she has to wear a pig mask on a date.

Dwayne tutors Denise in calculus late into the night and is forced to leave the locked all female dormitory via the fire escape; the problem is, the only way to get to the only unlocked exit is through Whitley's room.
A recently divorced friend of Cliff's (Wallace Shawn) "goes gaga" over Clair's pal Bernice (Mercedes Ruehl).
Olivia's (Raven-Symoné) day-care center becomes the proving ground for Denise's unorthodox teaching style.
The family is regaled with tales of life and Huxtable heritage by Cliff's 98-year-old aunt (Minnie Gentry).
Rudy is not looking forward to the first day of sixth grade; Vanessa goes off to college.
Kyle's singing performance at a local talent contest is disrupted by Maxine's presence; Regine coaches Khadijah.
Glówny serwis informacyjny TVP Info sumuje najwazniejsze i najciekawsze wydarzenia mijajacego dnia. Program ukazuje poszerzone spojrzenie na wydarzenia ze swiata, gospodarki i kultury.
Magazyn przedstawia dzialalnosc organizacji pozytku publicznego oraz formy aktywnosci obywatelskiej. Prowadzaca Joanna Bator rozmawia z aktywistami, którzy chca zmieniac swiat na lepsze.

Znany i lubiany slaski kucharz Remigiusz Raczka przygotowuje popularne i mniej znane dania kuchni regionalnej. Nierzadko decyduje sie na przyrzadzenie ich w wersji slaskiej. Mistrza kuchni ogranicza wylacznie jego wyobraznia.
W kazdym odcinku emitowanego codziennie programu w roli komentatorów wystepuja specjalisci z wybranych dziedzin, prezentowane sa wystepy muzyczne, a takze porady i segment kulinarny.

Cyrkl reportazy, który prezentuje najciekawsze pomniki i zabytki polskiej kultury.
Serwis informacyjny, nadawany co pól godziny, przedstawia najwazniejsze biezace wydarzenia.

Na zjezdzie absolwentów zamordowana zostaje liderka klubu zolz, grupy, która przed laty rzadzila w podstawówce. W toku sledztwa lista podejrzanych niebezpiecznie sie wydluza. Wydzial Gancarza szykuje sie do ostatecznej konfrontacji ze zlodziejami.

Mlody wikary jest surowym i bezkompromisowym duchownym: przeprowadza inspekcje wsi, punktuje wszelkie niedociagniecia i wszystko gani. Lucy z Kusym sa na cenzurowanym. Na wies pada strach. Wieclawscy ukrywaja w domu córke w ciazy.

Mlodziezówki partii politycznych zadaja pytania znaczacym postaciom swiata polityki i zycia publicznego - przedstawicielom wladzy, reprezentantom swiata kultury i nauki, a takze autorytetom z róznych dziedzin.

Zygmunt Mineyko, powstaniec styczniowy i inzynier, urodzil sie 11 maja 1840 roku na Wilenszczyznie. Ukonczyl gimnazjum w Wilnie, a nastepnie w 1858 roku wstapil do Mikolajewskiej Szkoly Inzynieryjnej w Petersburgu.
Audycja przedstawia podstawowy serwis informacyjny Telewizji Polskiej. Program ma charakter informacyjny, a prezentowane materialy pochodza czesto z regionalnych oddzialów nadawcy publicznego.
Program jest kontynuacja dotychczasowego cyklu emitowanego na antenie TVP Polonia. Stanowi o polskiej kulturze, a tworzony jest przez pasjonatów, dla których kultura jest codzienna potrzeba.

Urzednicy we wsi Polskie Pole zmagaja sie z problemami mieszkanców i wlasnymi sprawami prywatnymi. Wójt Eligiusz Czapla walczy o uzyskanie praw miejskich dla Polskiego Pola, skupiony na rozwoju swojej malej ojczyzny.

Dominika ponownie powierza opieke nad lokalem Renacie, aby umozliwic Matiemu spotkanie z Sonia. Tymczasem Daniel po flircie ze szpitalna rejestratorka spotyka sie z synem, usilujac narzucic mu wlasna wizje meskosci.

François Touraine est devenu un pianiste virtuose grâce à sa professeure Rachel, dont il est tombé amoureux; alors que la Seconde Guerre mondiale éclate, il doit faire un choix: Rachel est juive; pour tenter de la sauver, il part jouer en Allemagne.
Ce rendez-vous réveil-matin propose de faire un point sur l'actualité, assorti de différentes rubriques permettant d'explorer certains aspects plus en profondeur.

p.t: Le crime lui va si bien
p.d: On découvre dans un fossé, abattu d'une balle entre les deux yeux, un paisible réparateur de vélos d'origine italienne.

p.d: Au cours d'une promenade, des personnalités et un ou une de leur proche entament un dialogue pour se dire des choses essentielles ; un pas en avant pour libérer les mots et mieux se comprendre ; une marche autant qu'une démarche.

Claire revient à Montpellier après dix-sept ans d'absence, afin de faire découvrir à Théo, son fils adolescent, sa ville natale. Quelques heures plus tard, elle est en garde à vue, accusée du meurtre d'un ami d'enfance.

Reina la calma, todos los habitantes del jardín se quedaron dormidos. Tal vez, esto guarde relación con una familia de pequeños escarabajos de color púrpura a los que Holly rescató la noche anterior.
